wise.name: Wise
wise.licence: BNM-licensed remittance (Wise Payments Malaysia Sdn Bhd)
wise.limit: FPX pay-in up to RM30,000 per transfer

westernunion.name: Western Union
westernunion.licence: Operates in Malaysia; not on BNM's digital-licensee list (Merchantrade eRemit also pays out via WU). Licence entity not verified

instarem.name: Instarem
instarem.limit: RM50,000 per transfer; FPX pay-in up to RM30,000

worldremit.name: WorldRemit
worldremit.licence: Accepts senders in Malaysia; not on BNM's digital-licensee list (not verified)

cimb.name: CIMB SpeedSend
cimb.manual_note: Rate shown only inside CIMB OCTO / Clicks (live 8:30am-6pm MYT business days). Fee RM10 + 8% SST = RM10.80.

bigpay.name: BigPay
bigpay.manual_note: No public quote (website under maintenance). UK fee listed as RM6 on BigPay support; rate only in app.

sunway.name: Sunway Money
sunway.manual_note: No public quote endpoint found; rate and fee only in app.
